description: Create a deterministic benchmark that compares current file-level retrieval with graph-and-symbol retrieval, reports token savings and relevant-surface recall, and documents safe rollout criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The benchmark runs against fixed repository task fixtures without contacting external services.
The report includes baseline tokens, candidate tokens, reduction percentage, selected files, selected symbols, fallback count, and relevant-surface recall.
The benchmark detects regressions where token reduction comes from omitting explicit files, required tests, or policy-mandated context.
The rollout recommendation keeps the existing file-level behavior as the safe default until benchmark evidence supports enabling snippets.
The benchmark output and documentation explain how future repositories can reproduce the measurement.

planning.title: Measure context savings and relevant-surface recall
